authorship: Developer-authored by Codex domain/evaluation agent, including expected labels; no independent human adjudication.
scope: One scientific-style fictional nonclinical proposition per input. No treatment, medical efficacy, or clinical decision evaluation.
novelty: New fictional vocabulary and inputs, distinct from runtime replay fixtures and previous model pilot prompts. Parallel behavioral templates mean the splits are not independent linguistic distributions.
validation_protocol: Root and model prompt tuning use development inputs/labels only. Freeze prompt, contract, model revision and decoding before reading validation outputs/labels. Any tuned-after-validation set becomes regression data; create a new set for further unseen validation claims.
status: No model has been run against these files at freeze time.
claim_limit: Passing these 12 unseen developer-authored nonclinical cases is a small engineering check, not reliability or clinical validation.
